title: TypeScript Narrowing Design Plan
description: A structured plan for a TypeScript narrowing/type design -- goal, discriminant/guard/brand decisions, CI type-checks -- so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/typescript_narrowing_expert_audit.mjs.

goal.description: What this design is for: modeling a sum type, disambiguating IDs via brands, writing a user-defined type guard, composing conditional types, or repairing lost narrowing.

usesDiscriminatedUnion.description: True if the design models variants as a discriminated union.

discriminantIsLiteral.description: True if the discriminant is a literal type ('a' | 'b') in every variant, not string/number/enum.

hasExhaustivenessCheck.description: True if switches over the union have a default branch assigning to never.

typeGuardReturnsPredicate.description: True if user-defined guards are declared as `x is Foo`, not `boolean`.

bareAsCastCount.description: Count of `as` coercions outside brand factories in the touched code.

asCastsDocumented.description: True if every remaining `as` carries a same-line reason comment enforced by CI.

brandedTypesHaveFactory.description: True if each branded type has a validating factory and `as Brand` is banned outside it.

brandNegativeTypeTests.description: True if negative type-tests (expect-type/tsd) assert different brands are not assignable to each other.

narrowingCrossesCallback.description: True if a narrowed value is used inside a closure/callback created after the narrowing check.

narrowedValueCapturedAsConst.description: True if the narrowed value is captured into a const before the callback (or re-narrowed inside).

conditionalTypeAliasMaxLines.description: Length in lines of the largest conditional type alias in the design.

tscNoEmitInCI.description: True if tsc --noEmit runs in CI on every PR.

noImplicitAnyClean.description: True if domain code passes tsc --noImplicitAny with no `any` outside vendor/boundary files.

satisfiesPreferredOverAnnotation.description: True if `satisfies` is the default over widening annotations where narrow inference matters.
